blurb: Gary Olson Yoga offers hot yoga classes including Power Yoga and Bikram Yoga, meditation sessions, specialized courses like Hamsa Hatha Kriya and the PATH Course, and yoga retreats. Classes emphasize breath, body alignment, strength, balance, and mental clarity. The PATH Course is a guided personal journey of spiritual evolution rooted in Kriya Yoga.
